text:
marco: quick policy q - i'm leaving the company in Nov and have 4.25 PTO days and 1.5 sick bank. does unused PTO carry over or get paid out at termination? worried about accrual/carryover caps.
mina: hi @marco - good question. short answer: unused PTO is eligible for payout on termination (pro-rated based on your state/local rules) up to the annual cap. sick bank payout depends on local law; most locations do not pay out sick, but some states require it. which office are you in?
marco: SF office. also: if i have fractional days (like 0.25) how do we round for payout? manager told me they round up.
elaine: policy excerpt: "PTO balances are paid out at termination per local payroll rules. Fractional balances are paid to two decimal places (no rounding up) unless local law mandates otherwise." see https://hr.redwood.com/termination.
marco: thanks. and what about carryover to next year if i had been staying? our handbook mentions a 5-day carry cap. curious about interaction with leave encashment.
shelly: carryover cap is 5 days (40 hours) at year-end. if you go over, excess is forfeited unless you file an exception by Dec 15. encashment at termination still pays you what you have, but carryover rules only apply at the year boundary.
mina: to be explicit: if you'd stayed past year-end and had >5 days, you'd need to request a carryover exception or convert excess into calendar payout options. termination payout is separate and calculated from ledgered balance on your termination date.
marco: last thing - i used 2 half-days earlier this year and my portal shows 4.25 remaining. is half-day stored as 0.5 or do we convert to hours? how will payroll compute final payout?
elaine: we track balances in hours in the backend. half-days are stored as 4.0 hours (for an 8-hour day) or according to your contract day-length. payroll will compute final payout in hours and convert to currency at your final hourly/yearly rate.
people-ops-bot: FYI: Reminder - termination pay runs are processed on the next scheduled payroll run. For off-cycle requests, contact payroll@redwood.com.
marco: great, thanks. @mina can you confirm the exact payout estimate (hours -> $) so i can plan my notice date?
mina: will do. i'll pull the ledger and DM payroll to get an estimate; will post the summary here once confirmed. expected turnaround ~24 hours.
marco: appreciated!
mina: update: payroll confirmed estimated payout for current balance = 28 hours = $1,512 gross (pre-tax) based on your salary. sick balance not payable in CA unless documented under specific policy - payroll advises no sick payout. i'm sending the official calc to your inbox.
marco: perfect, thanks for the quick help everyone :pray:
